model_identity: YOLOv8n-pose ONNX; repository README download URL names Ultralytics assets release v8.2.0
model_version_note: The asset URL release label is repository documentation, not separately verified model-training metadata; SHA-256 identifies the exact file used.
person_detection_threshold_definition: Minimum person/detection confidence; independent from per-keypoint confidence.
person_detection_threshold_rationale: Matches PoseDetector::detect() default and the existing live inference loop's explicit 0.3 setting for parity; not claimed as scientifically optimal or empirically tuned.
keypoint_confidence_threshold_definition: Reporting validity cutoff only; raw keypoint coordinates and confidence values are preserved.
